content: Venezuela has a large and growing gap between official and black-market USD/VES exchange rates (roughly 85%+ gap as of 2025-2026), and the bolivar has devalued nearly 480% in 12 months in some periods. USD is used as the de facto pricing benchmark for stability. Locking a rate at time of quote vs time of payment is a known hard problem in hyperinflationary/volatile-currency contexts.
